entities.name: St Andrew's Church, Jerusalem
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St Andrew's Church, also known as the Scots Memorial Church, is a church in Jerusalem, built as a memorial to the Scottish soldiers who were killed fighting the Turkish Army during the Sinai and Palestine campaign of the First World War, bringing to an end Ottoman rule over Palestine. It is a congregation presbyterian of the Church of Scotland.
